Description

Optional. Allows more efficient burst accesses. Writing while busy sets cmderr=1 (if cmderr=0). Detect support by R/W test.

autoexecprogbuf

Bitmask (16 bits). If bit N=1, R/W to progbufN re-executes command in 'command' register.
